baseline: Unity 0.9.1 unreleased checkpoint; user stopped Unity verification to begin Unreal migration
units: Unity metres/seconds; Unreal uses centimetres and seconds

weapons.name: Ridgeline
weapons.description: Accurate long-range rifle. Slow follow-up shots; powerful against large wildlife.

weapons.name: Trail Scout
weapons.description: Controlled automatic rifle for medium-range engagements.

weapons.name: Brushmaster
weapons.description: Eight-pellet shotgun. Strong in close cover; limited reach.

weapons.name: Service Nine
weapons.description: Compact, dependable pistol. A modest start that leaves more budget for spawn priority.

weapons.name: Kestrel
weapons.description: Fast automatic fire for interiors and jungle cover. Shares ammunition with the pistol.

weapons.name: Longwatch
weapons.description: Scoped semi-automatic rifle. Flexible at range, but heavy on scarce ammunition.

weapons.name: Sawmill
weapons.description: Heavy automatic weapon. A large magazine trades quick handling for sustained fire.

weapons.name: Stormbreak RPG
weapons.description: A traveling explosive rocket. One shot, slow reload, blast falloff and cover protection. Carries dedicated rockets.

startingKits.name: Bare essentials
startingKits.description: Service pistol, one spare magazine. Save almost everything for selection priority.

startingKits.name: Light scout
startingKits.description: Kestrel SMG and sidearm. Light ammunition; you will need to scavenge early.

startingKits.name: Trail ranger
startingKits.description: Trail Scout carbine, sidearm, two spare magazines, and one medkit.

startingKits.name: Brush hunter
startingKits.description: Brushmaster shotgun, sidearm, two spare magazines, and one medkit.

startingKits.name: Field mechanic
startingKits.description: Carbine, sidearm, four repair materials, and one fuel can. Less spare ammunition.

startingKits.name: Ridgeline marksman
startingKits.description: Scoped rifle, sidearm, three spare magazines, and one medkit.

startingKits.name: Prepared expedition
startingKits.description: Uncommon Longwatch rifle, sidearm, three spare magazines, two medkits, tools, fuel, and a light vest.

startingKits.name: Armored hunter
startingKits.description: Shotgun, sidearm, two spare magazines, a medkit, and a field vest. Less priority for choosing a district.

locations.name: Ranger Refuge
locations.description: Medical supplies and modest weapons. Central access, with several teams likely to rotate past.

locations.name: Sunwash Sands
locations.description: Long desert sightlines. Rooms hide ammunition and occasional rare rifles; an old buggy sits outside.

locations.name: Windpump Works
locations.description: Fuel, tools, and a service pickup. A useful departure point when the storm moves east.

locations.name: Frostwatch Flats
locations.description: High-quality rifle odds and exposed approaches. The utility van needs repairs before it will run.

locations.name: Quarry Quarters
locations.description: Weapon cases and repair salvage among work sheds. Strong equipment odds, difficult terrain.

locations.name: Ridgeline Roost
locations.description: A visible landmark with precision weapons and limited vehicle fuel. Plan a route off the ridge.

locations.name: Fernwood Falls
locations.description: Close cover, medicine, and fast-firing weapons. The abandoned van may be worth restoring.

locations.name: Cedar Crossing
locations.description: Reliable ammunition and tool crates. Good woodland cover, with roads into the valley and rainforest.

locations.name: Reedwater Reach

locations.name: Lakeside Landing
locations.description: Shoreline supplies, wooded approaches, and a launch on the lake.
